reviews.title: Easy To Install
reviews.comment: This unit replaced an older water cooler that was struggling to keep the CPU on my gaming rig at optimum temperature. It was very easy to install and so far has been working like a charm. Just make sure you ise a thermal cooling paste between the coolimg plate and your processor. It seems like something that doesn't need to be said. But I've worked on on some rigs for other people and found AIO coolers and fans that had NO thermal paste applied. The price was pretty good too.
reviews.author: -BW from AZ

reviews.title: Early Review of TH120
reviews.comment: I needed a liquid cooler for my FX-9370 processor after my previous cooler failed.  The Thermaltake TH120 was the only one I could find.  My MB has an AM3+ socket.  It is old.  But the TH120 does fit this socket. I installed it earlier this morning, which was something of an issue, but after installation it keeps my processor cool, around 38C and it is very quiet.  Even with the case open, I do not hear it. My only complaint so far is the installation instructions and the design of the wiring - which I assume is a product of having to support both Intel and AMD and a bunch of their CPU sockets.  There are lots of connectors but only half of them are needed.  This is where the installation instruction could have been more descriptive. For the AMD the cooler mounts using the stock AMD  cooling fan bracket.  My previous cooler had its own mounting bracket which required the removal of the stock bracket.  Luckily, I had an extra AMD mounting bracket.  If you have a stock bracket in place then the installation of the TH120 is fairly easy. One other note if you install this cooler.  There is a 4 pin connector that connects the fan to the motherboard.  I connected this connector to the same 4 pin connector in the motherboard I used for my previous cooler.  But for some reason, this connector did not work with the TH120 fan. Again, luckily, I had another free 4 pin connector for a chassis fan which worked.  Before trying this I thought the fan was no good or something. I can't say the quality of the TH120 is great.  I doesn't feel like it.  But it works. Until I feel like upgrading my PC to something more modern, this will do nicely.  And the price is pretty good for a liquid cooler.
reviews.author: Slydrule
